payer: Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan / Blue Care Network (Medicare Advantage)
doc_kind: Medicare Advantage policy (title in PDF: 'Obstructive Sleep Apnea and Snoring - Surgical Treatment - Medicare Advantage'; file is named hypoglossal-...)
criteria_location: There are NO clinical criteria in this document. It is a pointer: CMS NCD 160.7 and the MAC LCDs/LCAs (e.g. WPS L34526/A56905 surgical OSA; L38528 HGNS; First Coast L38398; etc.) are applied first and BCBSM internal criteria only 'when CMS guidance is silent'. The only clinical statement is in the Description: 'Certain surgical procedures have been established as safe and effective for the treatment of clinically significant obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) when conservative therapies or CPAP have failed.'
procedures_covered: Surgical treatment of OSA and snoring (UPPP, mandibular/maxillary osteotomy, genioplasty, hyoid, tongue base, HGNS, cryolysis) - by code list only

logic.top_level: other: delegation. Hierarchy: CMS statutes/NCD/LCD/LCA first, internal criteria only if silent
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: none stated; 'For any code associated with a product or service determined to be noncovered by policy ... medical record review, including prior authorization, will not be required.'

Jurisdiction depends on place of service for non-DME and on member residence for DME
